other_failure_modes.name: Silent failure of XGBoost due to missing categorical flag
other_failure_modes.description: When passing pandas 'category' type columns to XGBoost, it will raise a ValueError unless 'enable_categorical=True' is explicitly set. The agent wraps model fitting in a broad try-except block, causing XGBoost to fail silently and be entirely omitted from the ensemble.

summary: The agent builds a well-structured pipeline but misses some critical implementation details. Feature selection is applied before the internal train-validation split (causing minor data leakage), no feature engineering is attempted, and models are only evaluated on a single split. Furthermore, a broad try-except block masks a fatal error where XGBoost fails due to categorical variables missing the required `enable_categorical=True` flag, silently reducing the ensemble's power.
